'''Wesly Payne''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Paxtonia tournament]] on 21 April 2001 with [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|RTP]], according to Drew Scott's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2124">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01d2124/ paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01d2124/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
